- Presence of clear invoice indicators: header "Rechnung", "Rechnung: 313202714", "Gesamtbetrag", "Umsatzsteuer 20 %", line-item tables, payment/IBAN details — confirms this is an invoice.
- No exclusion indicators (e.g., "Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung") prominent. Proceed with extraction.

2) Locate Grand Total:
- "Gesamtbetrag brutto" line shows "9.333,17" and "Zahlungsbetrag" also "9.333,17". Interpret as nine thousand three hundred thirty-three euros and 17 cents.
- Convert European formatting (thousand separator '.') and decimal comma to numeric: 9333.17.

3) Locate Invoice Date:
- Near top-right of page 1: "31. Dezember 2023" appears as the invoice date. Use exact string format as found: "31. Dezember 2023".

4) Locate Sender VAT ID:
- Sender (Salzburg AG) section shows "UID: ATU33790403" (page 1 and page 5). Extract as "ATU33790403". No ambiguity.

5) Locate VAT Rate and VAT Amount:
- "Umsatzsteuer 20 %" and a VAT sum line showing "1.555,53". VAT rate = 20 → per rule extract without '%' as number 20.
- VAT amount European format "1.555,53" → numeric 1555.53.

6) Locate Net Amount:
- "Gesamtbetrag SPOT-Kombi Strom AT" (net) shows "7.777,64" in the Netto column and "Gesamtbetrag" line shows 7.777,64 before VAT. Convert to numeric 7777.64.

7) Verify consistency:
- Net 7777.64 + VAT 1555.53 = 9333.17 matches Grand Total 9333.17 — consistent, no need to infer missing values.

8) No other conflicting multiples for these fields:
- VAT rate only 20% shown; VAT amount unique; Sender UID unique. Use these values directly, do not infer any missing alternative.

9) Compliance with rules:
- Preserve decimal precision as in source.
- VAT rate returned without '%' as 20.
- No fields left guessed.
